text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and roadmap in the opening paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents a controlled structure that previews its main points and develops them in an orderly way."},{"evidence":"three labeled body sections: 'Firstly,' 'Secondly,' 'Thirdly,'","quality":"paragraph development","description":"The essay builds each paragraph around a distinct controlling idea and supports it with extended elaboration."},{"evidence":"definitions like 'Confidence involves having trust and believing...'","quality":"explanatory depth","description":"The essay explains abstract ideas in a more fully developed and precise way."},{"evidence":"repeated 'For example' personal scenarios","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"The essay uses relevant examples to back up claims and connect ideas to experience."},{"evidence":"phrases like 'Despite not making it onto the team' and 'However, I felt very proud'","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay handles complex relationships such as contrast and concession with more controlled syntax."},{"evidence":"mostly accurate capitalization and punctuation throughout","quality":"conventions","description":"The essay shows stronger control of standard written English conventions with fewer distracting errors."},{"evidence":"wording such as 'benefits me more to set high expectations' and 'setting high aims will pose more benefits'","quality":"academic tone","description":"The essay maintains a more formal, reflective register suited to an argumentative school essay."}]}
